The '''HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport''', also known as the '''Imperial Combat Assault Transport''', the '''Juggernaut turbo tank''', and the '''Juggernaut transport vehicle''', was a model of large, ten-wheeled [[ground assault vehicle]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]] for the [[Galactic Empire]]. Unlike the [[HCVw A9 turbo tank]], which it resembled, the HCVw A9.2 was unarmed, which made it easy to attack. Around [[9 ABY]], an [[Morak Imperial remnants|Imperial remnant]] operating on [[Morak]] still used several such vehicles.

==Description==
Manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards]], the HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport was a large, blocky vehicle that moved about on ten heavy-duty wheels. It was divided into five segments, including a tapered<ref name="Handbook" /> twin<ref name="SWECG">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''</ref> [[cockpit]], boasting [[viewport]]s and a [[loudhailer]] in the front.<ref name="Handbook" /> Each section of the juggernaut had two heavy-duty wheels, which allowed the [[transport]] to traverse over any rough terrain, including mud, rock and sand.<ref name="SWECG" /> While it did not have any weapons,<ref name="Handbook" /> the HCVw A9.2 still qualified as a [[ground assault vehicle]], boasting thick armor to protect its occupant in battle.<ref name="Juggernaut Driver DB">{{Databank|imperial-juggernaut-driver|Imperial Juggernaut Driver}}</ref> Overall, it shared many similarities<ref name="Handbook" /> with the [[HCVw A9 turbo tank]], another wheeled assault vehicle built by Kuat Drive Yards.<ref name="Starships and Speeders">''[[Starships and Speeders]]''</ref>

==History==
Inspired by the turbo tanks used by the [[Galactic Republic]] in the [[Clone Wars]], the HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport was used by the Galactic Empire to move cargo and [[prisoner]]s across rough terrain.<ref name="Juggernaut DB">{{Databank|juggernaut-transport-vehicle|Juggernaut transport vehicle}}</ref>

[[File:Juggernaut-transport.png|thumb|right|245px|A HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport on Morak]]
In [[9 ABY]], five [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor|fall]] of the Empire at [[Endor]], such transports were still used on [[Morak]] as part of its [[Morak Imperial remnants|Imperial remnants]]. At least four Juggernauts were stationed on the [[Morak Imperial refinery|Imperial refinery]] there, including [[Juggernaut Three]], [[Juggernaut Four]], and [[Juggernaut Five]]. They were all destroyed during a [[mission to Morak]] undertaken by [[Din Djarin]], [[Carasynthia Dune]], [[Migs Mayfeld]], [[Fennec Shand]], and [[Boba Fett]].<ref name="Chapter 15" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport first appeared in "[[Chapter 15: The Believer|The Believer]]", the seventh episode of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' that was released on [[December 11]], [[2020]].<ref name="Ep Guide">{{SW|url=series/the-mandalorian/chapter-15-guide|text="The Believer" Episode Guide | The Mandalorian}}</ref>

After the release of the ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'' episode "[[Juggernaut (episode)|Juggernaut]]" on [[April 10]], [[2024]], in which the [[HCVw A9 turbo tank]] was prominently featured,<ref name="Juggernaut date">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/juggernaut-episode-guide|text="Juggernaut" Episode Guide | Star Wars: The Bad Batch}}</ref> the entry for the HCVw A9.2 juggernaut transport in the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]]<ref name="DB A9.2 old">{{Databank|juggernaut-transport-vehicle|Juggernaut transport vehicle|oldversion=20240815000000}}</ref> was updated to instead now feature an image of the HCVw A9 from the episode, but no other information in the entry was changed.<ref name="Juggernaut DB" />
